content: Human-labeling session — combat-harass-balanced-hit-and-run:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a pulsed worker-harass mission with twin cluster lanes. You are given 4 jeeps staged in the north (y=10) or south (y=30) lane depending on seed. Each lane has six unarmed worker infantry along x=72..92 on the lane latitude, and a heavy tank one row off the lane (north lane: post (82,5); south lane: post (82,35)). Your jeep machine guns cannot scratch the heavy's armour, and its cannon will one-shot a jeep. It guards its post: any of your jeeps that comes within about 16 cells makes it lunge, and it snaps back past about 18. Engage whichever cluster your spawn opens onto: strike a worker, retreat west of the cluster, let the heavy snap back, then re-engage. Three kills, zero jeeps lost, within about 60 turns.
